  • Constructor Details

    • BucklingCase

      public BucklingCase(String label, double distanceM, String designSituation, DnvRpF110GlobalBucklingResponseScreeningKernel.PipelineConfiguration configuration, DnvRpF110GlobalBucklingResponseScreeningKernel.DesignStrategy strategy, double effectiveCompressiveForceN, double callerControlledAllowableCompressiveForceN, double peakLongitudinalStrainFraction, double callerControlledAllowableLongitudinalStrainFraction, double peakGlobalDisplacementM, double callerControlledAllowableGlobalDisplacementM, double requiredFeedInLengthM, double availableFeedInLengthM)
      Create one caller-controlled external-analysis response case.
      Parameters:
      label - unique case label
      distanceM - route distance in m
      designSituation - design-situation identifier
      configuration - exposed or buried pipeline configuration
      strategy - controlled-buckling or prevention strategy
      effectiveCompressiveForceN - effective compressive-force magnitude in N
      callerControlledAllowableCompressiveForceN - externally established allowable force in N
      peakLongitudinalStrainFraction - peak longitudinal strain as a fraction
      callerControlledAllowableLongitudinalStrainFraction - externally established allowable strain
      peakGlobalDisplacementM - peak global displacement magnitude in m
      callerControlledAllowableGlobalDisplacementM - externally established allowable displacement in m
      requiredFeedInLengthM - externally derived required feed-in length in m
      availableFeedInLengthM - externally established available feed-in length in m
